posts.name: Nepycros
posts.cooked:
Mint.

 

I went with the straight up "Attack Dawn almost exclusively, worry about nothing else" route (though I did pop Summer).

Take Down was played after a bit to keep the field from getting too full, and then I followed it up a round later with End of Days. This let me worry about mostly just the on-board damage rather than any nasty wipes. In a damage race, I still got put down to 4 HP on all heroes before Dawn was knocked out.

It's lucky that after her Devastating Aurora, she only really plays chumps for a bit, including Spring which flipped her back after just one round immune.

posts.name: QuirkyDM
posts.cooked:
Had to settle for a Fine with this one. I wanted to save End of Days until later on, but getting her intial ongoing out of the way is probably more valuable as I see everyone else did it that way. As long as Asault and Battery weren't out together, I could mostly ignore the citizens, but then Citizen Truth and Citizen Anvil come out along with some painful environment cards and I get stalled for a few turns. Fourth game I finally won, but it was heroes at 3, 4 and 3.

I did use Sacrosanct Martyr to set up a nice 1 round smackdown. Hmm, on that note, Divine Focus is even better than normal for XPW Fanatic. Need to try again and not suck so bad this time. :)
